svg.title: The signed expression bounds supplying the initial continuation estimates follow a finite proof tree. Its leaves are bounded labels of degree d at one position, with price R−d, and the unit with price 1. One may multiply two already priced expressions when their position palettes are separated by a positive multiple of their common radius; their prices multiply. One may carry an expression from radius R to R′ when its palette has diameter O(R) about its chosen center and R = O(R′). Subtracting its full projection through degree h multiplies its price by (R/R′)h+1, with the same size condition and the fixed reader clearance. Projecting onto just degree h multiplies its price by (R/R′)h and replaces its palette by the center alone; no ratio bound is required for this projected operation. Palette enlargement is also permitted.
